g.text: Kit import of a released student
Every file hash equals the Hub original
cmd: just kit-import-check | pass: prints 'repo=... commit=<sha> files=N' then 'imported: wattson/import-check:v1'
cmd: just kit-import-check | pass: kit unpack exits 0 (no FAIL line)
cmd: just kit-import-check | pass: prints 'import-hash: files=N matched=N mismatched=0 missing=0'
cmd: just kit-import-check | pass: prints 'PASS kit-import: ...' and the scratch store is removed
